candidate.answerReason: In 300 seconds, Cagney frosts 15 cupcakes and Lacey frosts 10, totaling 25.

methods.label: Add their individual totals
methods.explanation:
Both people work for the full \(5\) minutes, which is \(5\cdot60=300\) seconds. Divide this time by each person's time per cupcake: Cagney frosts \(300\div20=15\) cupcakes, and Lacey frosts \(300\div30=10\). Adding their contributions gives
\[
15+10=\boxed{25}
\]
cupcakes, choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
methods.levelReason: Direct time conversion and whole-number division suffice; algebra is unnecessary.

candidate.annotationRationale: The target is translating time per cupcake into each person's production and combining the two totals. Time-unit conversion and division by two-digit numbers support that calculation.

review.mathematicalCheck: Five minutes equals 300 seconds. The individual totals are 300/20=15 and 300/30=10 cupcakes, so together they frost 25.
review.levelCheck: The short explanation uses appropriate time conversion and whole-number arithmetic.
